title: Standing Relief of the Returned-Payment Fee at Grace Cure — Premium Billing Accounts
content:
**Relief.** On Premium Billing Accounts, a standing relief is deducted from the grace-cure payment for a long-standing account with a clean return record. The relief is deducted after every amount added to the past-due premium; the total is then floored at 0.00 and rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Clean return record.** The account's returned payments within twenty-four months before the payment date are no more than its returned payments within the whole calendar months from the grace-period start date to the payment date, plus one. Both counts are made the way a record counts as falling within a number of months before the payment date: the whole calendar months from the record's date to the payment date, counted the way an anniversary is counted (a month is complete only when a later month reaches the same day number, and the last day of a shorter month does not complete it), are fewer than that number. So a return in the last days of the month before the grace-period start counts with the latter, and one dated exactly twenty-four whole months before the payment date with neither.

**The fee concerned.** The returned-payment fee booked last is the fee booked last on the account (of two booked on the same day, the one recorded first); it counts as booked in the grace period when its date is on or after the grace-period start date.

**Tiers** (tenure is the whole calendar months from the account's opening date to the payment date)
| Clean return record | Tenure | Fee booked last counts as booked in the grace period | Relief deducted |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | 60 months or more | yes | that fee in full |
| yes | at least 36 and fewer than 60 months | yes | 50 percent of that fee |
| any other combination | | | none |

**Boundary points.** Tenure of 59 whole months falls in the 50 percent tier; 60 in the full tier; 35 receives no relief.

**Hypothetical cases** (grace-period start date 1 August; payment date 19 October, so the grace count runs over 3 months).
- Opened 72 whole months before; one returned payment on 2 August with a 25.00 fee on 2 August; no other return in twenty-four months: 1 is no more than 1 — relief 25.00.
- Same, opened 40 whole months before: relief 12.50.
- Same as the first, plus a return the previous March: 2 against 1 — no relief.
